newsitem.title: USA: Just For Feet plans $100 mln note offer.
newsitem.headline: Just For Feet plans $100 mln note offer.

text.p: Just For Feet Inc said on Tuesday that it proposes to offer a new issue of $100 million Convertible Subordinated Notes due 2004.

The notes will be convertible into Just For Feet common stock, at the option of the holder, the company said. The company may also issue up to an additional $15 million of notes to cover overallotments made in connection with such offering, Just For Feet said.
Just For Feet said it intends to use the proceeds from the sale of the notes for general corporate purposes, including working capital to fund the company's expansion and for potential acquisitions.
